- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:257-269 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: render_prompt_with_semble_prefetch unconditionally cats the prefetch file even when the second argument is omitted or empty, which can hang future callers.
  WHY: Three reviewers flagged the empty-argument path in the command substitution as a runtime hang risk for judge prompt assembly.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:118-161 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The contract tests assert exact shell snippets, so cosmetic refactors or variable-name changes can fail CI even when the wiring is unchanged.
  WHY: Both reviewers noted that the tests match literal shell text rather than behavior, making them fragile to harmless formatting changes.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:318-328 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge hardcodes chunk count "4" in the live semble_query_block call instead of using the configurable chunk limit used by the other judge path.
  WHY: All three reviewers observed that this path ignores the shared chunk-count configuration and therefore behaves inconsistently across judge types.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:258-265 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: render_prompt_with_semble_prefetch defaults prefetch_file to an empty string and then runs cat "${prefetch_file}", which can hang if the helper is called without the second argument.
  WHY: The helper is unsafe for future callers because the command substitution would wait on stdin when prefetch_file is omitted.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:131-140, 148-161 | severity=medium | confidence=4

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:322-323 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge hardcodes the chunk count to "4" instead of using a configurable default.
  WHY: This creates inconsistent behavior versus the other judge path, which uses a helper default tied to chunk configuration.

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:257-265 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: render_prompt_with_semble_prefetch can hang when called without a second argument because it defaults prefetch_file to empty and still runs cat "${prefetch_file}".
  WHY: If the helper is invoked with a missing prefetch file argument, the command substitution can block waiting for stdin during prompt assembly.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:318-328 | severity=low | confidence=4

  WHY: Operators setting a higher chunk limit for other judge paths will still get only 4 chunks in the review-blocked path, creating inconsistent behavior.
